title: Writing a polite email
explanation: A formal email has a greeting, a clear purpose, and a polite closing. Start with 'Dear' and the person's title and name, say why you are writing, and end with a closing such as 'Kind regards'.
examples: I am writing to ask about the vacancy.
I look forward to hearing from you.

exercises.prompt: Which opening suits a formal email?
exercises.explain: 'Dear' plus a title and name is the standard formal greeting.
exercises.promptSo: Furitaan noocee ah ayaa ku habboon iimayl rasmi ah?
exercises.explainSo: “Dear” oo ay raacaan darajada iyo magaca qofka waa salaanta caadiga ah ee iimaylka rasmiga ah.

exercises.prompt: I am ___ to ask about the vacancy.
exercises.explain: 'I am writing to...' states the purpose of the email.
exercises.promptSo: Buuxi meel bannaan: “I am ___ to ask about the vacancy.”
exercises.explainSo: Weedha “I am writing to...” waxay sheegaysaa ujeeddada iimaylka.
“Kind regards” waa xiritaan edeb leh oo dhexdhexaad ah.

explanationSo: Iimayl rasmi ah wuxuu leeyahay salaam bilow ah, ujeeddo cad iyo xiritaan edeb leh. Ku bilow “Dear” oo raaci darajada iyo magaca qofka. Sheeg sababta aad u qorayso, kuna dhammee weedh xiritaan ah sida “Kind regards”.
examplesSo: Waxaan idiin soo qorayaa inaan wax ka weydiiyo booska shaqo ee bannaan.
Waxaan rajaynayaa inaan jawaab idinka helo.

title: Taking part in meetings
explanation: In meetings, use polite phrases to interrupt, agree, and move the discussion forward. Polite language helps colleagues listen to you.
examples: Sorry to interrupt, could I add something?
Let's move on to the next item.

options: Sorry to interrupt, could I add something?
exercises.promptSo: Sidee ayaad si edeb leh hadalka u dhex geli kartaa?
exercises.explainSo: Weedhani waxay muujinaysaa raalli-gelin waxayna oggolaansho waydiisanaysaa.
optionsSo: Waan ka xumahay inaan hadalka dhex galo; ma ku dari karaa fikrad?

exercises.prompt: How can you change the topic politely?
options: Let's move on to the next item.
exercises.explain: It is neutral and helps the group continue.
exercises.promptSo: Sidee ayaad mawduuca si edeb leh ugu beddeli kartaa?
exercises.explainSo: Weedhani waa dhexdhexaad waxayna kooxda ka caawisaa inay doodda sii waddo.

exercises.explain: 'I agree with that point' shows support.
exercises.explainSo: “I agree with that point” waxay muujinaysaa inaad taageersan tahay fikradda.

explanationSo: Marka aad shir ka qaybgalayso, adeegso weedho edeb leh si aad hadalka u dhex gasho, u muujiso inaad ku raacsan tahay qof, ama doodda ugu gudbiso qodobka xiga. Luqadda edebta leh waxay ka caawisaa asxaabta shaqada inay si wanaagsan kuu dhegaystaan.
examplesSo: Waan ka xumahay inaan hadalka dhex galo; ma ku dari karaa fikrad?
